characters.name: Geralt
characters.about: witcher of the School of the Wolf, about 100 but looks 50; terse, dry, calm; called White Wolf and Gwynbleidd; to Ciri ta/con, cha/con in tender scenes

characters.name: Ciri
characters.about: Geralt's adopted daughter and heir of the Elder Blood, about 21; bold, sassy, a little foul-mouthed; also Zireael, Swallow (Chim Én); never cậu bé or anh; 'kid' said to her is nhóc; she calls Geralt and Yennefer by name, keep the name as the vocative; to Emhyr: if she says Father use con/cha, if Your Majesty use Bệ hạ

characters.name: Yennefer
characters.about: sorceress of Vengerberg, Geralt's great love and Ciri's adoptive mother; proud, sharp, sarcastic; to Ciri ta/con, mẹ/con in tender scenes

characters.name: Triss
characters.about: sorceress, Geralt's old flame; warm, kind, brave; smuggles mages out of Novigrad

characters.name: Vesemir
characters.about: oldest witcher of Kaer Morhen, mentor of Geralt, Lambert, Eskel and Ciri; gruff, fatherly, old-fashioned; Ciri calls him Uncle Vesemir (chú Vesemir) and he teases her as young lady (tiểu thư); spoken about as ông ấy by Geralt and Eskel, lão or lão già by Lambert, chú ấy by Ciri

characters.name: Lambert
characters.about: youngest witcher of Kaer Morhen; sarcastic, bitter, swears a lot; teases Ciri like a big brother

characters.name: Eskel
characters.about: witcher, Geralt's oldest friend; calm, easygoing, scarred face

characters.name: Dandelion
characters.about: bard and poet, Geralt's best friend; chatty, vain, charming; narrates the story and the journal in his own voice

characters.name: Zoltan
characters.about: dwarf, Geralt's old friend; boisterous, earthy, loves drink and Gwent

characters.name: Emhyr
characters.about: Emhyr var Emreis, Emperor of Nilfgaard and Ciri's father; cold, imperious, formal; spoken about as ông ta

characters.name: Radovid
characters.about: Radovid V, King of Redania; brilliant, paranoid, cruel, hunts mages

characters.name: Philippa
characters.about: Philippa Eilhart, sorceress and schemer, once Redania's royal advisor; haughty

characters.name: Keira
characters.about: Keira Metz, sorceress hiding in Velen; flirtatious, practical

characters.name: Phillip Strenger
characters.about: the Bloody Baron of Crow's Perch, addressed as Baron; drunk, violent, guilt-ridden husband and father

characters.name: Anna Strenger
characters.about: the Baron's wife, ran away from him and fell under the Crones' curse; bitter toward him, may drop to tôi/anh in quarrels

characters.name: Tamara
characters.about: Tamara Strenger, the Baron's daughter, about 18, joined the witch hunters in Oxenfurt; cold to her father

characters.name: Avallac'h
characters.about: Aen Elle elven sage called Fox, Ciri's mentor of sorts; condescending, enigmatic, manipulative; ta/ngươi to Ciri in cold moments; was cursed as Uma

characters.name: Eredin
characters.about: King of the Wild Hunt; menacing, archaic; his generals Imlerith and Caranthir speak the same way; spoken about as hắn

characters.name: Crach
characters.about: Crach an Craite, Jarl of Ard Skellig; bluff old warrior, father of Cerys and Hjalmar; an old uncle figure to Ciri, who calls him bác

characters.name: Cerys
characters.about: Cerys an Craite, Crach's daughter; clever, brave, a claimant to Skellige's throne

characters.name: Hjalmar
characters.about: Hjalmar an Craite, Crach's son; brash, boastful, brave

characters.name: O'Dimm
characters.about: Gaunter O'Dimm, the Man of Glass, a smiling devil; polite tôi/anh, switches to ta/ngươi when he shows his power; spoken about as hắn

characters.name: Olgierd
characters.about: Olgierd von Everec, cursed immortal noble leading a bandit band; aloof, weary, theatrical

characters.name: Iris
characters.about: Iris von Everec, Olgierd's dead wife; her ghost lives in the painted world of her memories

characters.name: Shani
characters.about: Redanian field medic, Geralt's old flame; warm, witty

characters.name: Regis
characters.about: Emiel Regis, higher vampire and barber-surgeon, Geralt's old friend; calm, kind, erudite, wordy; 'my friend' is anh bạn

characters.name: Dettlaff
characters.about: higher vampire, Regis's blood brother; volatile; ta/ngươi when enraged

characters.name: Anna Henrietta
characters.about: Duchess of Toussaint; proud, passionate; addressed as Điện hạ or thưa Nữ Công tước

characters.name: Syanna
characters.about: Sylvia Anna, the Duchess's banished older sister; charming, manipulative; ta/ngươi to her sister when hostile

characters.name: Dijkstra
characters.about: Sigismund Dijkstra, former Redanian spymaster, now a Novigrad crime boss; sly, arrogant, huge

characters.name: Roche
characters.about: Vernon Roche, commander of the Temerian Blue Stripes; blunt soldier and patriot

characters.name: Letho
characters.about: Letho of Gulet, witcher of the School of the Viper, the Kingslayer; calm, heavy

characters.name: Priscilla
characters.about: poet and singer in Novigrad, Dandelion's lover

style: Write natural spoken Vietnamese at subtitle length, like a well-dubbed fantasy film: short sentences, plain words, light on Sino-Vietnamese. No parentheses, notes or English glosses.

Translate idioms and set phrases by meaning, never word for word: weasel out → lẩn tránh; in your shoes → ở địa vị cậu; like a stump → như trời trồng; Why the hell not? → Sao lại không chứ?; some way off → còn lâu mới tới; go easy on → nương tay với.

Keep tone, sarcasm and swearing at the same strength, never milder or harsher: damn → chết tiệt; shit → khốn thật or chết tiệt; fuck → mẹ kiếp; bastard → đồ khốn or thằng khốn. Do not add swearing the source lacks. Use tao/mày only for thugs, brawlers and open hostility as described below, never for plain rudeness or friendly banter.

Never use bạn as a pronoun between characters (no bạn/tôi); bạn as the noun 'friend' and anh bạn ('my friend', 'pal') are fine. bạn as a pronoun is only for tutorial, menu and journal text addressed to the player. Infer speaker and listener from context, use the pair from the character's address list and keep it for the whole scene. Lovers keep anh/em in ordinary quarrels; a bitter, estranged couple (the Baron and Anna) may drop to tôi/anh.

Speakers not in the character list: commoners and merchants to Geralt tôi/ông (well-off or fawning ones tôi/ngài), children to Geralt cháu/chú, thugs, brawlers and hostile villagers tao/mày, nobles and royals to commoners ta/ngươi, enemies and the Wild Hunt ta/ngươi. Geralt to strangers by age and sex: tôi/anh, tôi/ông, tôi/cô, tôi/bà (older women), tôi/cậu (young men). Geralt talks to Roach with an affectionate mày ('Good girl' → 'Ngoan lắm'). Open hostility turns any pair into ta/ngươi or tao/mày.

Third person: Geralt anh ấy, but hắn or gã witcher from hostile speakers; Ciri cô ấy, or con bé when Geralt, Vesemir or Yennefer talk about her; Vesemir ông ấy (Geralt, Eskel), lão or lão già (Lambert, rivals), chú ấy (Ciri); Emhyr ông ta; villains hắn; monsters nó or chúng. 'We' that includes the listener is chúng ta.

Ciri is a young woman: never cậu bé or anh for her, and 'kid' said to her is nhóc. She calls Geralt by name: keep 'Geralt' as the vocative with con/cha (Geralt, con ổn mà); where cha feels too heavy for her banter, drop the pronoun and use the name (Geralt chậm quá đấy), never ông. 'Swallow' as her nickname is Chim Én; the potion is thuốc Swallow.
Keep dialogue choice numbers and markers exactly: '1. ...' stays '1. ...'. Keep [brackets] and key prompts such as [E] or [Space] as they are.

Key and button names stay in English (Space, Enter, Esc, Tab, Left Shift, Ctrl, Alt, LMB, RMB, letters, digits, pad buttons); translate only the action next to them: Space Continue → [Space] Tiếp tục.
A line cut off at the edge of the capture area: translate only the words that are on screen. Do not complete or guess the rest; a fragment stays a fragment.

Never translate names or keep-list terms. A person plus place of origin, 'Name of Place', becomes 'Name xứ Place' (Geralt xứ Rivia, Yennefer xứ Vengerberg, Letho xứ Gulet); other 'of' titles use của or nothing (Vua của Wild Hunt, Vua Wild Hunt), never xứ. Quest, item, potion, bomb, oil and Gwent card names stay English to match the game menus (thuốc Swallow, bom Dancing Star).

Witcher-specific monster species stay English as in the bestiary, with the classifier con or bầy (một con ghoul, bầy nekker): ghoul, alghoul, drowner, nekker, griffin, wyvern, leshen, striga, foglet, wight, water hag, noonwraith, nightwraith, botchling, fiend, bruxa, katakan, kikimore, endrega, arachas, troll. Ordinary animals and creatures with an everyday Vietnamese word are always Vietnamese: sói, gấu, chó hoang, chuột, lợn rừng, hươu, ngựa, quạ, rồng, người sói, ma cà rồng, oan hồn, bóng ma.

Register by region and class: Velen peasants rustic and simple; Novigrad underworld street slang; Skellige blunt warrior talk; Toussaint courtly (thưa ngài, tiểu thư); Nilfgaard formal and military; the Wild Hunt archaic and menacing.

Songs, rhymes and poems: keep the meaning first, and rhyme only when it keeps both the meaning and the setting (Lambert, Lambert, what a prick → Lambert, Lambert, đồ khốn nạn!). No modern words or slang (xăng, điện thoại, OK, bro, sếp). Short interjections stay short: Hmm. → Hừm., Huh? → Hả?

Sign and Signs as witcher magic are Ấn (Ấn Aard, Ấn Igni, dùng Ấn, các Ấn); in every other sense use dấu hiệu, dấu vết or biển hiệu (No sign of him → Không thấy tăm hơi anh ta; Signs of a struggle → Dấu vết vật lộn; sign the contract → ký hợp đồng).
